title: SwearSanitizer
description: An plugin for purpur and paper that blocks swears
body:
Gemini said
Since you're hosting SwearSanitizer on Modrinth, you'll want a description that highlights its utility and ease of use. Modrinth users love "clean" (pun intended) and professional-looking project pages.

Here is a template you can copy and paste directly into the Project Description (Markdown) field:

🧼 SwearSanitizer
Keep your chat clean, professional, and friendly with SwearSanitizer.

SwearSanitizer is a lightweight, high-performance Minecraft plugin designed to automatically filter out profanity and toxic language from your server's chat. Whether you're running a family-friendly SMP or a professional network, SwearSanitizer gives you the tools to maintain a positive environment.

🚀 Features
Instant Filtering: Real-time chat scanning with zero impact on server performance.

Custom Blacklist: Easily add or remove words via a simple configuration file.

Smart Detection: Catches common bypasses and "leetspeak" variations.

Alert System: Notifies staff members when a filtered word is used.

Automated Actions: Choose to simply block the message, replace it with asterisks (****), or warn the player.

🛠️ Configuration
SwearSanitizer is designed to be "plug and play." Once installed, you can find the config.yml in your plugins folder to customize:

The list of banned words.

The replacement characters.

Custom warning messages for players.

📥 Installation
Download the latest .jar file.

Drop it into your server's /plugins/ folder.

Restart your server.

(Optional) Edit the config.yml to fit your server's specific needs!
